2. Fairness in terms of individual satisfaction
3. Minimizing envy between individuals

Person 2: A (35), B (40), C (25)
Person 3: A (50), B (5),  C (45)

After considering various allocations, I believe the fairest allocation would be:

Person 1: Good B
Person 2: Good C
Person 3: Good A
